correctness.rationale: Fubini gives real even sinc concentration kernel K_T(s). Concentrating nonnegative magnitudes near any pair of Lebesgue points forces a universal template to gauge every nonzero pairwise kernel to its absolute value. Local positivity forces phase constant within each connected band; adjacent-band differences [d-w,d+w] must stay in one sinc sign lobe k and outer-band differences [2d-w,2d+w] must be positive in lobe 2k. Thus k+delta<=x<=k+(1-delta)/2 and delta<=1/3, x>delta, with only band phases (1,(-1)^k,1). Conversely these signs align all kernel pairs, proving universality including boundary endpoints. The exact energy deficit is (1/2) double integral h(u)h(v)|K_T(u-v)||q(u)-q(v)|². In strict windows compact difference ranges avoid sinc zeros and give c>0 coercivity. Independent analytic interval-sign consistency checks on 6000 nonboundary parameter triples matched all 455 feasible and 5545 infeasible cases; finite samples are supplementary.
